notes: Multi Studio version 3.0.0: **Doc Text Replacer Studio**: A brand-new story script revision and batch text patcher designed for writers, narrators, and storytellers. Inspired by Grammarly's intuitive review cards, you can paste full scripts alongside revision notes (Original Line / Patched Line pairs) to preview matches in real time, apply changes individually or in one-click bulk passes, and track diffs side by side without tedious manual search-and-replace., **Direct Rich Text Story Canvas**: Write, edit, or paste story scripts directly into a distraction-free manuscript canvas with quick formatting tools for scenes, bolding, italics, dialogue quotes, and dividers, without confusing intermediate clipboard popups., **Persistent Workspace & Panel Sizing**: Your story manuscript, loaded revision patches, and custom resizable panel width are now automatically saved and restored whenever you restart the application., **Movable & Resizable Patch Importer Dialog**: The Import Script Patches window can now be freely dragged across your screen by its header bar and resized from any corner or edge. It automatically remembers your custom window size and position across application restarts, and includes a handy one-click reset button in the header to return to the centered default., **Side-by-Side Patch Importer**: Import patch notes with an intuitive two-column dialog that displays your pasted revision notes on the left and live detected patch cards on the right., **Synchronized Scrolling & High-Contrast Diff Inspector**: Upgraded the Document Diff Inspector with real-time synchronized dual-column scrolling, vibrant red (original/deleted) and green (patched/added) line styling, word-level diff highlights, and flexible font size options (`A-`, `A`, `A+`) for comfortable reading., **Dedicated Clear Workspace Action**: Added a prominent "Clear Workspace" button on the main toolbar, allowing you to reset both your story manuscript and all patch rules in one click whenever needed., **Contextual Import Patches Placement**: Relocated the "Import Patches" button from the top-left document toolbar directly into the Suggestions & Patches sidebar header right next to "Add Rule", keeping patch actions grouped together logically., **Responsive Copy Script Action**: Enhanced the "Copy Script" button with dual-method clipboard copying and an animated emerald confirmation badge ("Copied to Clipboard!")., **Reliable Baseline Checkpointing**: The "Checkpoint Baseline" button now provides immediate visual confirmation when clicked, and clearing patches automatically synchronizes the baseline to eliminate lingering phantom diffs., **Beginner-Friendly Rule Creator**: A streamlined rule creation dialog with helpful guides, clear input explanations, and a one-click sample filler., **High-Contrast Options & Export Menus**: Redesigned the Match Options and Export dropdowns with wide, card-based layouts, helpful descriptions, and clear format badges., **English Mystery Demo Script**: An engaging detective mystery story script featuring Blackwood Manor and 9 revision rules for immediate one-click testing., **macOS Setup Installer Wizard (.pkg)**: In addition to the standard disk image (.dmg), macOS releases now include a native setup installer package (.pkg). Double-clicking the setup installer guides you through an installation wizard that automatically installs Multi Studio directly into your Applications folder without requiring drag-and-drop., **Enhanced Disk Image Presentation**: Streamlined the layout and icon positioning inside the macOS disk image (.dmg) for an intuitive, clean drag-and-drop installation experience., **Smooth Manual Script Writing**: Resolved an issue where manual typing in the manuscript canvas could stop or lose focus on keypress, allowing uninterrupted, natural writing and editing of story scripts., **Isolated Undo and Redo in Dialogs**: Fixed a keyboard shortcut conflict where pressing Undo (`Cmd+Z` / `Ctrl+Z`) or Redo while typing inside modal dialogs (such as the Import Script Patches window or rule editor) mistakenly altered the background manuscript instead of your active text., **Aligned Side-by-Side Diff Inspector (Zero Drift)**: Rebuilt the side-by-side Diff Inspector with paired row grid alignment. Corresponding lines from the original baseline and current script now share the exact same row height and scroll together natively in a single unified view. When lines wrap or expand into multiple lines, the opposing side stretches to match, guaranteeing that subsequent lines stay level and never drift or misalign., **Persistent Resizable Workspace Panels**: The split layout between your document editor and the suggestions sidebar is now saved strictly upon manual adjustment, ensuring your custom panel sizes persist reliably across application restarts without resetting to default., **Smart Patch Heading Truncation**: Patch scene and category headings now cleanly truncate with an ellipsis (`...`) when horizontal space is constrained in narrow panels or cards, complete with a hover tooltip displaying the full text to keep card layouts crisp and clutter-free., **Streamlined "Load Example" Placement**: Relocated the sample story loader to the right section of the main toolbar alongside other workspace controls and simplified its label to "Load Example" across the toolbar, dialogs, and empty states., **Targeted Word-Level Diff Highlighting (Thai & Multi-Language Support)**: Upgraded diff highlighting with linguistic word segmentation (`Intl.Segmenter`), providing pinpoint word-level red (removed) and green (added) badges even in continuous, non-spaced languages like Thai and Asian scripts, as well as across English and Latin text., **Targeted Diff Highlights in Suggestion & Importer Cards**: Suggestion cards in the sidebar and detected patch preview cards in the Importer dialog now highlight the exact modified words inside original and patched lines, replacing uniform full-sentence strike-throughs with crystal-clear visual diffs., **Synchronized Scrolling in Patch Importer**: Added smooth, proportional two-way synchronized scrolling between pasted revision notes and detected patch cards in the Import Script Patches dialog, complete with a quick header toggle button., **Clean Suggestions & Patches Header**: Redesigned the suggestions sidebar header with a balanced two-column action grid and a discrete clear icon, eliminating cramped text wrapping and awkward button misalignment., **Diff Inspector Baseline Alignment**: Resolved an issue where the baseline column in the Diff Inspector appeared blank when editing scripts by automatically tracking initial text checkpoints., **Clean State on Rule Reset & Clear**: Reverting or clearing patch rules now accurately restores the original baseline text and clears phantom diff highlights.
